purpose: pre-register the bounded improvement experiment, the development-to-holdout continuation gate, and the stop rules before any candidate result is seen

baseline_definition.description: original architecture/recipe (yolov8n-pose 1-keypoint, same preprocessing) re-trained on the frozen v4 train/val with the same budget as candidates; old exploratory final and old one-shot metrics are kept for traceability but are NOT the comparison baseline for improvement (they stay exploratory evidence)
baseline_definition.comparison_metric: validation joint narrow-primary (GT-observable positives with complete labels; prediction UNKNOWN/REJECTED count as misses)
secondary_metrics: identity precision and high-confidence false-match rate
anchor px and horizontal bearing error

requirements: each candidate must map to a confirmed root cause from the post-evaluation diagnosis
priority order: data/labels, preprocessing, keypoint expression/loss, identity rejection
forbidden: unjustified larger networks, segmentation, threshold stacking

pilot_advance_gate.rule: a candidate advances to the 3-seed phase only if, at matched pilot budget, validation joint improves by >= 0.05 absolute over the matched baseline AND identity high-confidence false-match rate is not worse AND reference coverage is not lower than baseline by more than 0.02
pilot_advance_gate.otherwise: candidate rejected; keep evidence; do not tune it further

development_to_holdout_gate.rule: only if the winning candidate (3 seeds, selected on validation) meets ALL of:
conditions: val joint improvement over matched baseline >= +0.08 absolute
identity high-confidence false-match rate <= baseline at the frozen validation threshold
worst-group joint not worse than baseline worst-group by more than 0.05
development_to_holdout_gate.on_fail: STOP this route version: no new holdout capture, no new test; deliver failure diagnosis, root-cause evidence and a route recommendation instead
development_to_holdout_gate.on_pass: freeze improvement protocol/artifacts and capture a new holdout (>=3 new trajectory families, 200-400 frames, covering small target, close-range truncation, target absent, real map confuser, same-frame ambiguity); coverage/sampling rules frozen before capture; labels by a process-isolated annotator; final candidate/thresholds/decoder/eval rules frozen, then exactly one holdout evaluation

holdout_rules.annotation: same frozen spec v2.1+, QA PASS; register who viewed images, purpose and time; same-agent execution is called PROCESS-ISOLATED HOLDOUT, not third-party sealed or certification truth
holdout_rules.evaluation: once only after model/thresholds/decoder/eval rules frozen; no callback, no retune, no rerun
holdout_rules.on_failure: stop this version of the experiment; report failure

boundaries: internal bounded research only; distribution decision pending
no control, no PPO, no gate promotion
weights/ONNX/logs stay ignored; repository keeps configs, sources, hashes and readable conclusions
RKNN/board/real camera remain UNKNOWN unless separately evidenced
